findings.source_quote: God has designed marriage to be powerfully bonding. The spiritual, emotional, and physical attachment of marriage creates an inseparable bond. In Genesis we read Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh –Gen 2:24. The word cleave in this verse denotes “being welded or glued together in such a way as to be inseparable.”
